header: Set up Desiderio in four steps
description: You need no configuration files and no licence key. If you prefer, we install and set up Desiderio on your TYPO3 site for a fixed €890.

items.title: Install the package
items.content: Run composer require webconsulting/desiderio in a TYPO3 v14.3 project. The extension registers all 244 content elements, the Fluid 5 components and the theme layer. You do not need a template project.

image.title: Developer installing Desiderio
image.alternative: Hands typing on a laptop keyboard.

items.title: Seed the styleguide
items.content: The command vendor/bin/typo3 desiderio:styleguide:seed builds a complete demo page tree with every element. It is safe in workspaces, and running it again creates no duplicates.

image.title: Desiderio page module previews
image.alternative: The TYPO3 page module showing seeded Desiderio content elements with their previews.
image.description: Screenshot of a TYPO3 v14 site with Desiderio.

items.title: Choose a theme preset
items.content: Choose one of 15 theme presets in the site settings, or give part of the page tree its own preset. The seeded styleguide uses a different preset on each chapter page. Every preset includes dark mode and checked contrast.

image.title: Desiderio site settings theme category
image.alternative: The Desiderio theme settings in TYPO3, with the preset selection.
image.description: Screenshot of a TYPO3 v14 site with Desiderio.

items.title: Build your pages
items.content: Open the content wizard and build pages from the ten element groups. Every element has a backend preview and example content, so editors can start on day one.

image.title: Desiderio new content element wizard
image.alternative: The TYPO3 content wizard listing the ten Desiderio element groups.
image.description: Screenshot of a TYPO3 v14 site with Desiderio.
